new_senses.gloss: to abolish, erase, remove (a polity or its name)

Party as affected subject after the coup, followed by other parties, supports abolition. lġe without l-agent is provisionally filed Detransitive Preterit; one passage, morphology unconfirmed.

added_examples.turoyo: W lġele mi xariṭa i ḥkume d Ašur, mərle: "Haṯe bala yo li arʕo kula!"
added_examples.translation: And he erased the government of Assyria from the map; he said: "This is a calamity for the whole earth!"
added_examples.rationale: New entry: explicit political object and map source; no invented Infinitiv or Infectum.

added_examples.turoyo: Mi arʕo lġele əšmayye w maḥrale Nənwe

added_examples.translation: Then the Democrat became strong, until a coup took place against the Democrat. Then the Democrat was abolished, and other parties came into being.
added_examples.rationale: Provisional new Detransitive cell; political patient and outcome explicit.
